theorems.name: Submission.allard_tc_tpr_weight_eq_restrict
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (M E : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ), (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → μ K ≠ ∞) → SFinite ((μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)).restrict M) → E ⊆ M → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x ∧ HasDensity n μ x (ENNReal.ofReal (θ x))) → (∀ B : Set (Euclidean N), MeasurableSet B → μ B = ∫⁻ x in E ∩ B, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μHE[n]) → ∀ B : Set (Euclidean N), MeasurableSet B → μ B = ∫⁻ x in M ∩ B, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μHE[n]
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
